title: Kiritani Haruka — An Idol To Be Proud Of〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: An Idol To Be Proud Of（4★）

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I've gotten smaller?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It's true...
It feels like you two are so big now.
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Wait—
Aah!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Whoa! Are you okay, Haruka?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes... I just tripped.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
What's going on here?
How did she and I switch bodies?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: This is a SEKAI, after all. It makes sense that strange things could happen here.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're soooo cute!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ah! M-MEIKO?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hey, that's not fair... I mean!
MEIKO, now is hardly the time for that!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I can't help it! She's just so adorable♪
Look how squishy her cheeks are!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hee... Hehe...!
MEIKO, that tickles.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, there's a cute smile♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Now this feels more like the Haruka we know. Up until now, your expression has been rather stiff.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Right...
I wasn't very good at smiling when I was young.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I remember my parents looking sad and my mom saying, “If only it were easier to make you smile, Haruka.”

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Looking sad...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The other Haruka said something like that, too. Is there some connection?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I don't know, but...

rows.Speaker: Haruka?
rows.Line: But we will make them sad again, for sure.

rows.Speaker: Haruka?
rows.Line: As long as I'm an idol...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ever since I became an idol, I've made my parents sad countless times.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: When I first debuted, people online criticized me for not smiling enough, for being a terrible dancer, for using connections to get where I was...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: My mother found me crying in my room...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She looked like she was in so much pain, because of me.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Even after I became ASRUN's leader, people mostly just compared me with the previous leader.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: By then, I had stopped caring about what they had to say about me, but I think it never stopped eating at my parents.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Then, Mai got injured...
When I couldn't bear standing on stage anymore...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: My parents took time off work to spend time with me, helped me look for doctors, and gave me lots of support. But...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In the end, I gave up on being an idol.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
When I said I wanted to quit...
My mother cried.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She didn't say anything. She just hugged me, tears streaming down her face...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
But I couldn't find any words to thank her.
I really do feel like I was a terrible daughter.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And then after all that, saying I wanted to be an idol again... How selfish could I be?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But my parents just said I could do whatever I wanted to do...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They sound like wonderful parents.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I don't want to cause them any worry.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I don't want them to be sad because of me anymore.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But that...
That's impossible, so long as you're an idol.
se_walk_women_003_1

rows.Speaker: Haruka?
rows.Line: I need you to grasp your own position here, so it's about time we compare answers.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Answers?

rows.Speaker: Haruka?
rows.Line: Yes. Whose emotions this SEKAI was born from, and what kind of emotions they are.

rows.Speaker: Another Haruka
rows.Line: This is my and your... Our SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Another Haruka
rows.Line: It was born from the feeling we've been holding on to since we were very small. “I don't want them to be sad because of me.”

rows.Speaker: Another Haruka
rows.Line: I can tell you have somewhat figured that out.

rows.Speaker: Another Haruka
rows.Line: So you should also understand what needs to happen to turn that feeling into reality.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I do understand.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Ever since I became an idol, any time anything happens, my parents worry for me.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (They've been my strongest supporters, but I've made them sad so many times, and I feel terrible about it.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I've wondered sometimes, if I hadn't become an idol and lived an ordinary life, could I have been a better daughter to them?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But, I...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: MEIKO, KAITO...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You have your answer, don't you? But you're not sure if it's the right one?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
It's okay.
Just say how you feel, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
The one you're talking to is yourself, no one else.
You don't have to lie to yourself.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That day, on that stage, I learned that I could make people smile.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me, the little girl who could only make her parents worried...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As an idol, I could put a smile on everyone's face.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I won't quit.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I will remain an idol.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Since you're me, I'm sure I don't need to tell you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I treasure the idols who gave me my smile.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I am grateful for the idols who taught me I could share that smile with someone else.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The idols who give their fans courage to stand up and face another day...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I cherish them with all my heart.

rows.Speaker: Another Haruka
rows.Line: Even though being an idol makes your parents sad?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's not right. It's just that I still have a lot to work on.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Someday, I'll definitely become an idol my parents can be proud of.

rows.Speaker: Another Haruka
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Another Haruka
rows.Line:
I knew, deep down.
That was how I'd answer.

rows.Speaker: Another Haruka
rows.Line: I feel the same...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Phew... It looks like we made it back safely.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. Haruka, are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It was a bit of a shock, though.
Learning that those feelings of mine... Had a SEKAI of their own.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Maybe it was our SEKAI's way of giving you a chance to face your feelings head-on♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And at the very end, when the mist cleared, that SEKAI was truly beautiful.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It had all those photos of you beaming!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's true.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (An idol my parents can be proud of.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (It's a promise, and I intend to keep it.)
